text:
rachel: Quick sync on finalizing fetch strategy for the JS/TS SDK. goal: make DX frictionless for Edge + modern Node while keeping server fallback for older Node. proposal: prefer global fetch, dynamic undici import if missing, plus a deterministic env override for CI.

tom: +1 to prefer globalThis.fetch. avoids shipping undici into edge bundles. dynamic import for Node fallback seems good. also prefer making undici an optionalDependency for our server build artifact so installs for edge-only apps don't pull it.

neha: typing headache: we should expose SDK types using Web Fetch types (RequestInit/Response) so Deno/edge/modern Node users get correct typings. For Node-only users who need DOM lib, include a tiny types shim `types/dom-fetch.d.ts` that has `/// <reference lib="dom" />` and re-exports. docs should tell users to add "lib": ["ES2021","DOM"] if they see missing types.

kevin: auth & retry: we must ensure the auth wrapper composes the same regardless of underlying fetch implementation. suggest a factory `createSdkFetch({auth, retry})` that returns a wrapped fetch function. it should accept an optional explicit fetch param to allow tests to inject a fake fetch. streaming differences are notable: pin undici to a version with Web Streams support and add integration tests for large streaming responses on Node 18/20, Vercel Edge, Deno.

rachel: packaging note: use conditional exports so bundlers resolve edge entry without undici. example in package.json: "exports": {".": {"import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs","require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs","node": "./dist/node/index.js","browser": "./dist/edge/index.mjs"}} keeps edge builds clean. add an explicit server bundle that lists undici as optionalDependency.

tom: runtime-detect helper idea: `async function resolveFetch({force, envOverride}) { if (envOverride === 'undici') return (await import('undici')).fetch; if (envOverride === 'global') return globalThis.fetch; if (typeof globalThis.fetch === 'function') return globalThis.fetch; if (typeof process !== 'undefined' && process.versions?.node) return (await import('undici')).fetch; throw new Error('no fetch available'); }` allow overriding with SDK_FETCH env var for CI.

neha: docs snippet for users: 
- Edge (Cloudflare, Vercel Edge, Deno, Bun): rely on global fetch.
- Node 18+: prefer global fetch; if missing, dynamic undici fallback will be used.
- Node <18: add `npm i undici` or use our server bundle.

kevin: troubleshooting checklist to add to docs: 
- "Cannot find module 'undici'": install `undici` in server deps or use server bundle.
- "TS error: Property 'body' does not exist on type 'Response'": add "lib": ["DOM"] to tsconfig or use our types shim.
- "Edge lambda includes undici": check package.json exports and ensure the edge entrypoint is selected by the bundler.

doc-bot: CI job triggered: fetch-adapter-matrix (node18,node20,deno,bun,vercel-edge) started.

tom: CI determinism: add SDK_FETCH env override to force the undici path or global path so tests don't change behavior depending on runner Node version. also add an integration matrix that runs both code paths.

neha: TS packaging: add `types/fetch-shim.d.ts` and point `types` field in package.json to it. include short example `/// <reference lib="dom" />` so projects that lack DOM libs get better hints.

kevin: sample code for docs: 
```ts
import { createSdkFetch } from '@redwood-inference/sdk';
const fetch = await createSdkFetch({ auth: bearerAuth, retry: defaultRetry, envOverride: process.env.SDK_FETCH });
const res = await fetch('/v1/generate', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
```
use that pattern for examples in Next.js (app/edge vs pages/api) and Next pages where server/runtime differs.

rachel: action items: tom to open runtime helper + env override PR, neha to add types shim + docs, kevin to add auth/retry wrapper + streaming tests, and we'll update package.json exports + optionalDependency. i'll file one ticket to track and link PRs. thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
